romanizationNote: ALA-LC-flavoured Modern Standard Arabic in Latin letters: long vowels ā ī ū; emphatic and pharyngeal consonants ḥ ṣ ḍ ṭ ẓ; ʾ = hamza (a catch in the throat), ʿ = ʿayn; the definite article is written al- and hyphenated onto its noun, assimilating before sun letters (al-qahwa, but ash-shāy); tāʾ marbūṭa is written -a; stress is not marked. Every display string in this course follows this one scheme — the word index matches surfaces verbatim, so a second scheme would break resolution.
